method: Error-free reference 150-mers at 1kb spacing; fraction remapping exactly to origin at MAPQ30; not exhaustive mappability
control_criteria: 3-5 external windows within absolute GC 0.01 and sampled mapping fraction 0.05; controls reused
limitations: Reference-derived single-end probes omit individual variation, sequencing error and paired-end rescue
Regular 1kb sampling is a proxy, not exhaustive uniqueness
Outside regions not confirmed diploid; controls reused and windows correlated
No formal CNV likelihood or SV genotype; coverage cannot resolve repeat-associated junction
